relations.subject: Nyoshül Khenpo Rinpoche
relations.evidence: At age eighteen, he studied Longchen Nyingthig teachings and Dzogchen at the Nyoshul monastery.

relations.subject: Nyoshül Khenpo Rinpoche
relations.evidence: In India, Rinpoche studied under the second Dudjom Rinpoche (Jigdral Yeshe Dorje), Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche, and the sixteenth Karmapa (Rangjung Rigpe Dorje).

relations.subject: Khyentse Norbu
